summary.headline: Planetary Hours and Activities
summary.text: Chapter thirteen explains the planetary rulership of the days and the sequence of planetary hours for day and night. A table assigns planetary-hour cycles and recommended activities—such as cupping, letter-writing, building, trade, seeing rulers and scholars, and beginning works—for each weekday.
